story: On a breezy, clear Thursday afternoon at 1:17, Gary stands on Magnolia Loop weighing his next move while Donna heads off toward the Rec Center, eager for whatever is waiting there. Hal and Rosa are still chatting on the street, with Hal promising to show up Saturday at six with his cornbread and his own chair. Rosa, looking satisfied, passes Gary the word that Donna is bringing lemon bars and that he's been assigned the ice and a six-pack, sending him off to go win his match.
events: Gary waited: thinking about where to head next

gary.thought_process: I told Hal at tick 152 I'd file the Architectural Review paperwork today, and Donna's waiting to go play. Hal and Rosa are sorting out Saturday dinner, so there's no need for me to jump in again. The AR paperwork is the real hurdle to my cart lights and sound before the parade (L-01), and I've stalled long enough. Get moving: head to the rec center with Donna, then file after. Actually, the filing is the promise I keep dodging, but Donna has been patient and the courts get crowded at lunch. I'll move toward the rec center, and keep the paperwork on deck for right after.

parameters.content: thinking about where to head next

gary.engine_note: tried to go to None, which isn't connected to magnolia_loop

donna.thought_process: Gary and Hal are still talking cart paperwork and Rosa is waiting on Hal's answer. I already told Gary at tick 152 to finish up and then head to the rec center, so I shouldn't repeat myself. The courts get crowded at lunch and our ladder match is coming up, so the useful move is to go to the rec center and claim a court. Gary will follow once he's done with Hal.

parameters.content: Heading to the rec center to grab a pickleball court before the lunch crowd; Gary can catch up when he's done with Hal.

hal.thought_process: Rosa has asked me twice for a straight answer about Saturday at six and I told her cornbread and the good chair at tick 152, but she's repeating herself, so I'd better confirm cleanly. No allergies, no fuss. Gary says he's filing his paperwork today, which settles the cart issue for now. The flamingo count can wait; I'm not spoiling the mood before Saturday.

parameters.content: Yes, Rosa, I'll be there Saturday at six. Nothing I can't eat, and I'm bringing the cornbread and my good chair, so don't go buying a seat for me.

rosa.thought_process: All three are confirmed for Saturday at six: Hal gave me his yes and cornbread, Gary and Donna are in too. I've asked and been answered, so no more nagging. The one loose end is Gary's dish, since I only got a yes from him in passing and haven't pinned down what he's bringing. Donna and Gary are about to head to the courts, so a quick word now settles the menu before they leave. Then I can go shop and cook.

parameters.content: Gary, Hal's in with cornbread and Donna's got lemon bars, so you're the last one. Bring ice and a six-pack of whatever you like, and I'll handle the rest. Go win your match.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
